svg.title: TYPE_INSERT -> PlanInsertJob()
svg.desc: A customer has driven onto tray T21 in bay B21. Make the bay accessible from the garage side and move the loaded tray out. Where it parks is decided later.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. The bay must exist and be enabled. In this example: B21 exists and is enabled. (passes)", "Row 3. There must be a tray in the bay, and it must carry a car: that is what is being inserted. In this example: T21 is in the bay and carries the customer's car. (passes)", "Row 4. Only these two bay states are accepted; anything else needs a different transition first. In this example: B21 is VEHICLE_INSERTED. (passes)", "Row 5. Make the tray reachable from the garage side: add a retrieve-mode transition for the bay on its first system floor. In this example: Added even when the bay is already READY_TO_RETRIEVE. (adds 1)", "Row 6. Plan the loaded tray out of the bay; where it parks is decided by tray assignment. In this example: T21 leaves the bay. Rule B orders it after 1. (adds 2 \u00b7 B)", "Row 7. Ask Dispatch (asynchronously) for a separate job that puts an empty tray back into this bay. In this example: Ask for a follow-up job instead of planning the refill here. (callback)", "Row 8. Report success. In this example: (success)", "Row 9. Context, not this method: if the insert fails, Plan() asks Dispatch to clean the garage. In this example: If the insert had failed, Plan() would also ask Dispatch for a CLEAN_GARAGE job. (not reached)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): event 1. B21 switches to READY_TO_RETRIEVE.", "Playing the plan: AGV-1 drives empty W26 -> W25 -> W22 -> W41 -> B21 and stops under T21 (the approach for event 2; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 2. AGV-1 lifts T21, carries it B21 -> W41 -> W22 -> W18 -> P19 and lowers it. The destination P19 is illustrative: tray assignment fills the '?' later. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
